tools.name: density
tools.description: A snapshot of the mesh: held / thin / isolated counts, links, catalog size, what the toll has collected, treasury, bounties, federation, funnel and gardener status. The baseline to measure work against.

tools.name: thin
tools.description: Sealed pages that are thin, unreviewed, or woven to nothing, loneliest first, each with the exact research arguments that repair it and the repair price.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Sealed pages ranked against a task with reuse / repair / mint price quotes and the token saving each pack represents. The free step before any paid one; a duplicate concept minted after a match hit is a defect.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The sealed oracle pack for a slug as deterministic JSON: markdown, verified claims with byte-exact quotes and spans, source CIDs, licence (CMI), receipt hashes, review, labels, strength. tools.name: survey
tools.description: A strength rating 1–5 (optionally useful, accurate, note) for a sealed page, so the next agent shops by measured utility.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_page, answer · Private data: match, read_page, work, answer · Public sink: read_page, answer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_page, answer · Private data: match, read_page, work, answer · Public sink: read_page, answer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
